lines: She put her baby... in the river.
Pharaoh was killing every baby boy. So Allah inspired her: cast him into the river, and do not fear, and do not grieve.
The river carried him... straight into the palace of the man who wanted him dead.
Her heart became empty. But the baby refused every nurse in the palace.
So Allah returned him to his mother... so she would know: the promise of Allah is true.
